text: 人面不知何处去，桃花依旧笑春风
pinyin: rén miàn bù zhī hé chù qù, táo huā yī jiù xiào chūn fēng
literal: person's · face · not · know · where · gone, peach · blossoms · as before · smile · spring · breeze
natural: The beautiful face has gone I know not where; the peach blossoms still smile in the spring breeze

meaning.en: Scenery unchanged while the loved one is gone; quoted for nostalgia, lost love and the sadness of change.
meaning.zh: 景物依旧而人已不见，常用来感叹物是人非、旧情难再。

equivalents: the scene remains but the person is gone
things are the same, people are not

examples.zh: 重回故地，他叹道“人面不知何处去，桃花依旧笑春风”。
examples.en: Returning to the old place, he sighed '人面不知何处去，桃花依旧笑春风'.

examples.zh: 老同学已四散各地，真是“人面不知何处去，桃花依旧笑春风”。
examples.en: Old classmates have scattered; truly '人面不知何处去，桃花依旧笑春风'.

story.en: By tradition, Cui Hao met a girl at a house south of Chang'an one spring; when he returned the next year the door was locked, and he wrote this poem on it.
story.zh: 相传崔护清明独游长安城南，遇一女子；次年重访，门已锁，题诗于门。

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions and speeches.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案和演讲。

text: 柴门闻犬吠，风雪夜归人
pinyin: chái mén wén quǎn fèi, fēng xuě yè guī rén
literal: brushwood · gate · hear · dog · bark, wind · snow · night · returning · person
natural: At the brushwood gate a dog barks; someone is coming home through the wind and snow of the night

meaning.en: A cosy image of someone returning home on a cold night; quoted for the warmth of home after a hard journey.
meaning.zh: 风雪夜里有人归家的温馨画面，常用来表达归家的温暖。

equivalents: someone's coming home through the snow
the warmth of coming home

examples.zh: 除夕夜的车站，处处是“柴门闻犬吠，风雪夜归人”的画面。
examples.en: On New Year's Eve the station was full of scenes of '柴门闻犬吠，风雪夜归人'.

examples.zh: 家乡的老屋，让他想起“柴门闻犬吠，风雪夜归人”。
examples.en: The old house in his hometown reminded him of '柴门闻犬吠，风雪夜归人'.

origin.source: 刘长卿《逢雪宿芙蓉山主人》

story.en: From a quatrain in which Liu Zhangqing, travelling at dusk in snow, lodges with a hill-dweller.
story.zh: 刘长卿旅途遇雪，投宿山中人家所作。

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions and speeches.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案和演讲。

text: 春潮带雨晚来急，野渡无人舟自横
pinyin: chūn cháo dài yǔ wǎn lái jí, yě dù wú rén zhōu zì héng
literal: spring · tide · bringing · rain · evening · comes · fast, wild · ferry · no · person · boat · by itself · lies across
natural: The spring tide brings rain, rushing in by evening; at the wild ferry no one is about, and a boat drifts crosswise by itself

meaning.en: A tranquil, empty scene of nature carrying on without people; quoted for stillness and detachment, or for being left idle.
meaning.zh: 野渡无人、小舟自横，宁静而空旷，常用来形容闲适，也喻怀才无人赏识。

equivalents: an empty boat drifting at the ferry
a boat left to drift

examples.zh: 画展上有一幅“春潮带雨晚来急，野渡无人舟自横”的水墨画。
examples.en: There is an ink painting of '春潮带雨晚来急，野渡无人舟自横' at the exhibition.

examples.zh: 雨后码头静悄悄，真是“春潮带雨晚来急，野渡无人舟自横”。
examples.en: After the rain the quay was quiet, truly '春潮带雨晚来急，野渡无人舟自横'.

story.en: Wei Yingwu wrote this as prefect of Chuzhou, at the western stream just outside the city.
story.zh: 韦应物任滁州刺史时，游城西涧所作。

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions and speeches.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案和演讲。

text: 月黑雁飞高，单于夜遁逃
pinyin: yuè hēi yàn fēi gāo, chán yú yè dùn táo
literal: moon · dark · wild geese · fly · high, Chanyu · night · flee · escape
natural: The moon is dark and the wild geese fly high: the Chanyu is fleeing in the night

meaning.en: A night-time scene of enemy rout; quoted for victory over an enemy under cover of darkness.
meaning.zh: 描写敌军趁黑夜仓皇逃遁，常用来形容夜里克敌制胜或敌人溃逃。

equivalents: the enemy slips away in the dark
a night rout

examples.zh: 影片开头引用“月黑雁飞高，单于夜遁逃”交代背景。
examples.en: The film opens by quoting '月黑雁飞高，单于夜遁逃' to set the scene.

examples.zh: “月黑雁飞高，单于夜遁逃”，这首边塞诗充满了紧张感。
examples.en: '月黑雁飞高，单于夜遁逃': this frontier poem is full of tension.

story.en: The first of Lu Lun's six 'Frontier Songs', whose next lines imagine pursuing the fleeing enemy through snow.
story.zh: 卢纶《塞下曲》六首之三，下文写追击逃敌、大雪满弓刀。

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions and speeches.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案和演讲。

text: 西塞山前白鹭飞，桃花流水鳜鱼肥
pinyin: xī sài shān qián bái lù fēi, táo huā liú shuǐ guì yú féi
literal: Xisai · hill · front · white · egrets · fly, peach · blossoms · flowing · water · mandarin fish · plump
natural: Before Xisai Hill white egrets fly; peach blossoms drift on the stream and mandarin fish grow plump

meaning.en: A lively rural picture of spring and a carefree, fisherman's life; quoted for pastoral beauty and a simple, free life.
meaning.zh: 描绘春天水乡渔隐生活的悠然景象，常用来形容田园风光和自在的生活。

equivalents: egrets, peach blossoms and plump fish
a carefree fisherman's life

examples.zh: 乡间民宿的招牌写着“西塞山前白鹭飞，桃花流水鳜鱼肥”。
examples.en: The sign of the country guesthouse reads '西塞山前白鹭飞，桃花流水鳜鱼肥'.

examples.zh: 退休后他钓鱼度日，颇有“西塞山前白鹭飞，桃花流水鳜鱼肥”的意趣。
examples.en: In retirement he spends his days fishing, in the spirit of '西塞山前白鹭飞，桃花流水鳜鱼肥'.

story.en: Zhang Zhihe, a Tang recluse who called himself the 'Fisherman of the Misty Waves', wrote this around Huzhou.
story.zh: 唐代隐士张志和（号烟波钓徒）游湖州一带时所作。

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions and speeches.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案和演讲。

text: 花开堪折直须折，莫待无花空折枝
pinyin: huā kāi kān zhé zhí xū zhé, mò dài wú huā kōng zhé zhī
literal: flowers · bloom · worth · picking · straight away · should · pick, don't · wait · no · flowers · in vain · break · branch
natural: When flowers are ready to be picked, pick them at once; don't wait until none remain and break an empty branch

meaning.en: Seize the day and the chance before it is gone; quoted to urge people to act while the time is right.
meaning.zh: 要抓住时机，不可等到错过才后悔，常用来劝人及时行动或及时行乐。

equivalents: seize the day
strike while the iron is hot

examples.zh: “花开堪折直须折，莫待无花空折枝”，机会不等人。
examples.en: '花开堪折直须折，莫待无花空折枝': opportunity won't wait.

examples.zh: 朋友劝他早点表白，“花开堪折直须折，莫待无花空折枝”。
examples.en: His friend urged him to confess early: '花开堪折直须折，莫待无花空折枝'.

story.en: 'Gold-thread Robe', ascribed to the Tang singer Du Qiuniang (the authorship is not certain); the poem urges treasuring youth over wealth.
story.zh: 相传为唐代杜秋娘所作（作者尚有争议），诗劝人珍惜青春而非金缕衣。

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions and speeches.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案和演讲。

text: 中庭地白树栖鸦，冷露无声湿桂花
pinyin: zhōng tíng dì bái shù qī yā, lěng lù wú shēng shī guì huā
literal: central · courtyard · ground · white · trees · roost · crows, cold · dew · without · sound · wets · osmanthus
natural: The courtyard ground is white and crows roost in the trees; cold dew silently wets the osmanthus

meaning.en: A quiet Mid-Autumn night in the courtyard, moonlight like frost; quoted for the beauty of a moonlit autumn night.
meaning.zh: 中秋夜庭院月光如霜、露湿桂花的静谧景象，常用来形容秋夜月色。

equivalents: moonlit courtyard on an autumn night
dew on osmanthus under the moon

examples.zh: 中秋之夜，院子里“中庭地白树栖鸦，冷露无声湿桂花”，格外清幽。
examples.en: On Mid-Autumn night the courtyard was '中庭地白树栖鸦，冷露无声湿桂花', serene.

examples.zh: 语文课上赏析“中庭地白树栖鸦，冷露无声湿桂花”的意境。
examples.en: In Chinese class we appreciated the mood of '中庭地白树栖鸦，冷露无声湿桂花'.

story.en: Wang Jian's poem on the full moon of the fifteenth night, written to a friend; it ends 'tonight everyone gazes at the moon, but whose house does autumn longing fall upon?'.
story.zh: 王建中秋十五夜望月寄友之作，下文“今夜月明人尽望，不知秋思落谁家”。

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions and speeches.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案和演讲。

text: 粉骨碎身浑不怕，要留清白在人间
pinyin: fěn gǔ suì shēn hún bù pà, yào liú qīng bái zài rén jiān
literal: powder · bones · smash · body · completely · not · fear, want · leave · purity · in · human · world
natural: I'm not afraid to be ground to powder, as long as I leave purity in the world

meaning.en: Fearless integrity: willing to die rather than lose one's honour; quoted to praise incorruptible officials and heroes.
meaning.zh: 宁愿粉身碎骨也要保持清白，常用来赞美廉洁正直的人和英烈。

equivalents: integrity above life
to leave a spotless name behind

examples.zh: 廉政教育基地的墙上刻着“粉骨碎身浑不怕，要留清白在人间”。
examples.en: '粉骨碎身浑不怕，要留清白在人间' is carved on the wall of the integrity education centre.

examples.zh: 他用“粉骨碎身浑不怕，要留清白在人间”自勉，一生清廉。
examples.en: He encouraged himself with '粉骨碎身浑不怕，要留清白在人间' and stayed honest all his life.

story.en: Yu Qian, the Ming minister who defended Beijing against the Mongols in 1449, used quicklime as a symbol of unbending purity.
story.zh: 明代于谦（1449年北京保卫战的主持者），以石灰自喻坚贞清白。

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions and speeches.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案和演讲。

text: 千磨万击还坚劲，任尔东西南北风
pinyin: qiān mó wàn jī hái jiān jìng, rèn ěr dōng xī nán běi fēng
literal: thousand · rubbings · ten-thousand · blows · still · firm · strong, let · you · east · west · south · north · wind
natural: Through a thousand rubbings and ten thousand blows it is still firm and strong; blow as you like, winds from east, west, south and north

meaning.en: Unyielding resilience under every kind of pressure; quoted for perseverance in hardship.
meaning.zh: 历经磨难仍然坚强不屈，常用来形容坚韧的品格。

equivalents: bend but never break
stand firm whatever the wind

examples.zh: 面对种种打击，他坚持“千磨万击还坚劲，任尔东西南北风”。
examples.en: Faced with every blow, he held to '千磨万击还坚劲，任尔东西南北风'.

examples.zh: 校训取自“千磨万击还坚劲，任尔东西南北风”。
examples.en: The school motto comes from '千磨万击还坚劲，任尔东西南北风'.

story.en: A poem by the Qing painter-poet Zheng Xie (Zheng Banqiao) on bamboo growing among rocks.
story.zh: 清代书画家郑燮（板桥）题咏岩石中生长的竹子。

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions and speeches.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案和演讲。

text: 落红不是无情物，化作春泥更护花
pinyin: luò hóng bù shì wú qíng wù, huà zuò chūn ní gèng hù huā
literal: fallen · red petals · not · be · heartless · things, turn · into · spring · mud · even more · protect · flowers
natural: Fallen petals are not heartless things; turned into spring mud, they go on protecting the flowers

meaning.en: Even after leaving office or life, one keeps nourishing the next generation; quoted in praise of teachers, mentors and selfless dedication.
meaning.zh: 即使凋零也继续滋养后来者，常用来赞美老师、前辈和无私奉献的精神。

equivalents: still giving after falling
selfless dedication to the next generation

examples.zh: 教师节，学生们献上“落红不是无情物，化作春泥更护花”。
examples.en: On Teachers' Day, students offered '落红不是无情物，化作春泥更护花'.

examples.zh: “落红不是无情物，化作春泥更护花”，老工程师退休后仍指导年轻人。
examples.en: '落红不是无情物，化作春泥更护花': the old engineer, though retired, still guides the young.

story.en: Written by Gong Zizhen in 1839 as he resigned from office and left Beijing, saying that he still cared for the nation.
story.zh: 1839年龚自珍辞官离京南归，诗中表示自己仍心系国事。

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions and speeches.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案和演讲。

text: 我自横刀向天笑，去留肝胆两昆仑
pinyin: wǒ zì héng dāo xiàng tiān xiào, qù liú gān dǎn liǎng kūn lún
literal: I · myself · hold across · sabre · toward · sky · laugh, depart · remain · liver · gall · two · Kunlun
natural: I laugh at the sky with my sabre across me; those who go and those who stay both have courage as great as Kunlun

meaning.en: Heroic fearlessness in the face of death; quoted to praise martyrs and brave reformers.
meaning.zh: 面对死亡毫不畏惧的豪迈气概，常用来赞颂志士和英烈。

equivalents: laugh at death
a hero's courage

examples.zh: 纪录片结尾引用谭嗣同的“我自横刀向天笑，去留肝胆两昆仑”。
examples.en: The documentary ends by quoting Tan Sitong's '我自横刀向天笑，去留肝胆两昆仑'.

examples.zh: 历史课上讲起戊戌六君子的“我自横刀向天笑，去留肝胆两昆仑”。
examples.en: History class spoke of the martyrs of 1898 and their '我自横刀向天笑，去留肝胆两昆仑'.

story.en: Tan Sitong wrote this on the wall of his cell in 1898 after the failed Hundred Days' Reform, before he was executed.
story.zh: 1898年戊戌变法失败后，谭嗣同在狱中题壁，不久就义。

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions and speeches.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案和演讲。

text: 山河破碎风飘絮，身世浮沉雨打萍
pinyin: shān hé pò suì fēng piāo xù, shēn shì fú chén yǔ dǎ píng
literal: mountains · rivers · shattered · wind · blows · catkins, life · fortunes · float · sink · rain · beats · duckweed
natural: Mountains and rivers are shattered like catkins in the wind; my life rises and sinks like duckweed beaten by rain

meaning.en: National collapse and personal fate; quoted for the pain of a nation in ruin and a life tossed by events.
meaning.zh: 国家破碎、个人命运飘零，常用来形容国破家亡的悲痛。

equivalents: a ruined homeland and a drifting life
at the mercy of the storm

examples.zh: 读到“山河破碎风飘絮，身世浮沉雨打萍”，我想起了那段屈辱的历史。
examples.en: Reading '山河破碎风飘絮，身世浮沉雨打萍', I thought of that humiliating history.

examples.zh: 纪念馆里展出了“山河破碎风飘絮，身世浮沉雨打萍”的手稿。
examples.en: The memorial hall displayed the manuscript of '山河破碎风飘絮，身世浮沉雨打萍'.

story.en: Wen Tianxiang wrote this in 1279 as a captive of the Yuan army on the Lingding Ocean, shortly before the final Song defeat; the poem ends 'Since ancient times who has not died? Let me leave a loyal heart shining in the annals'.
story.zh: 1279年文天祥被元军俘获，船过零丁洋所作；结尾为“人生自古谁无死，留取丹心照汗青”。

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions and speeches.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案和演讲。

text: 死去元知万事空，但悲不见九州同
pinyin: sǐ qù yuán zhī wàn shì kōng, dàn bēi bù jiàn jiǔ zhōu tóng
literal: die · go · originally · know · ten-thousand · things · empty, only · grieve · not · see · nine · provinces · united
natural: Once dead, I know everything is nothing; my only sorrow is not to see the nine provinces reunited

meaning.en: A patriot's dying regret that his country is not reunified; quoted for patriotic longing and an unfulfilled wish.
meaning.zh: 爱国者临终遗憾未能看到祖国统一，常用来表达家国情怀和未竟的心愿。

equivalents: a dying wish to see the nation united
patriotic longing to the end

examples.zh: 陆游临终留下“死去元知万事空，但悲不见九州同”。
examples.en: Lu You on his deathbed left the words '死去元知万事空，但悲不见九州同'.

examples.zh: 他把“死去元知万事空，但悲不见九州同”当作终生的心愿。
examples.en: He took '死去元知万事空，但悲不见九州同' as his lifelong wish.

story.en: Lu You's last poem, written for his sons at about the age of eighty-five, hoping they would tell him when the Song armies recaptured the north.
story.zh: 陆游八十五岁临终前所作，嘱咐儿子在王师北定中原时告知于他。

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions and speeches.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案和演讲。

text: 了却君王天下事，赢得生前身后名
pinyin: liǎo què jūn wáng tiān xià shì, yíng dé shēng qián shēn hòu míng
literal: finish · lord · king's · world · affairs, win · life · before · body · after · fame
natural: To complete the sovereign's task of unifying the realm, and win fame in life and after death

meaning.en: An ambition to accomplish great deeds and earn lasting fame; quoted for aspiration and the pursuit of renown.
meaning.zh: 立志完成大业、留下生前身后的名声，常用来表达建功立业的抱负。

equivalents: to accomplish great things and be remembered
glory in life and in death

examples.zh: 青年时他的理想就是“了却君王天下事，赢得生前身后名”。
examples.en: In his youth his ambition was '了却君王天下事，赢得生前身后名'.

examples.zh: 演讲中他引用“了却君王天下事，赢得生前身后名”，引来掌声。
examples.en: He quoted '了却君王天下事，赢得生前身后名' in his speech and drew applause.

origin.source: 辛弃疾《破阵子·为陈同甫赋壮词以寄之》

story.en: Xin Qiji wrote this lyric for his friend Chen Liang, recalling his youth fighting the Jin; the last line (not quoted) laments his white hair.
story.zh: 辛弃疾写给友人陈亮的壮词，追忆早年抗金，结句慨叹“可怜白发生”。

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions and speeches.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案和演讲。

text: 我见青山多妩媚，料青山见我应如是
pinyin: wǒ jiàn qīng shān duō wǔ mèi, liào qīng shān jiàn wǒ yīng rú shì
literal: I · see · green · hills · very · charming, suppose · green · hills · see · me · should · be · so
natural: I find the green hills so charming; I suppose they find me the same

meaning.en: A mutual, affectionate regard between person and nature, or between kindred spirits; quoted for friendly rapport and self-confidence.
meaning.zh: 人与山互相欣赏，也指知己间的惺惺相惜，常用来形容和谐相处与自信。

equivalents: as I see them, so they see me
a meeting of kindred spirits

examples.zh: 登山之后，他说“我见青山多妩媚，料青山见我应如是”。
examples.en: After the climb he said '我见青山多妩媚，料青山见我应如是'.

examples.zh: 他们俩脾气相投，真是“我见青山多妩媚，料青山见我应如是”。
examples.en: The two get along perfectly, truly '我见青山多妩媚，料青山见我应如是'.

origin.source: 辛弃疾《贺新郎·甚矣吾衰矣》

story.en: Xin Qiji wrote it in his old age at a pavilion in Jiangxi named Tingyun; the poem compares himself to the mountains in his loneliness.
story.zh: 辛弃疾晚年在江西铅山停云堂所作，以青山自比，抒发孤傲。

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions and speeches.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案和演讲。

text: 稻花香里说丰年，听取蛙声一片
pinyin: dào huā xiāng lǐ shuō fēng nián, tīng qǔ wā shēng yī piàn
literal: rice · flowers · fragrance · within · talk of · bumper · year, listen · to · frog · sound · one · stretch
natural: In the scent of rice flowers they talk of a good harvest; listen, a chorus of frogs on every side

meaning.en: A summer night in the country, with the promise of a good harvest; quoted for rural prosperity and a good year ahead.
meaning.zh: 夏夜田园，稻香蛙鸣，预示丰收，常用来形容农村的丰收景象和好年景。

equivalents: the scent of rice flowers and frog song
a good harvest in sight

examples.zh: 夏夜下乡，处处是“稻花香里说丰年，听取蛙声一片”的景象。
examples.en: On a summer night in the countryside, everywhere was the scene of '稻花香里说丰年，听取蛙声一片'.

examples.zh: 农业展览会用“稻花香里说丰年，听取蛙声一片”作宣传语。
examples.en: The agricultural fair used '稻花香里说丰年，听取蛙声一片' as its slogan.

origin.source: 辛弃疾《西江月·夜行黄沙道中》

story.en: Xin Qiji, living in retirement in Jiangxi, wrote it on a night walk on the Huangsha road.
story.zh: 辛弃疾闲居江西时，夜行黄沙岭道中所作。

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions and speeches.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案和演讲。

text: 天下英雄谁敌手？曹刘。生子当如孙仲谋
pinyin: tiān xià yīng xióng shéi dí shǒu, cáo liú, shēng zǐ dāng rú sūn zhòng móu
literal: world · heroes · who · rival · match? Cao · Liu. beget · son · should · be like · Sun · Zhongmou
natural: Who in the world is a match for a hero? Cao and Liu. To have a son, let him be like Sun Zhongmou

meaning.en: Praise of Sun Quan as a man of true heroism; quoted for admiring a capable young leader.
meaning.zh: 赞扬孙权的英雄气概，常用来称赞年轻有为的领袖。

equivalents: Sun Quan was the true match for Cao and Liu
I'd want a son like him

examples.zh: 看到这位年轻企业家，人们想起“天下英雄谁敌手？曹刘。生子当如孙仲谋”。
examples.en: Seeing the young entrepreneur, people recalled '天下英雄谁敌手？曹刘。生子当如孙仲谋'.

examples.zh: 三国迷常引用“天下英雄谁敌手？曹刘。生子当如孙仲谋”来称赞孙权。
examples.en: Three Kingdoms fans often quote '天下英雄谁敌手？曹刘。生子当如孙仲谋' to praise Sun Quan.

origin.source: 辛弃疾《南乡子·登京口北固亭有怀》

story.en: Xin Qiji at Beigu Pavilion in Jingkou (Zhenjiang), remembering Sun Quan; the line originally quotes Cao Cao's words about Sun Quan.
story.zh: 辛弃疾登镇江北固亭怀古，句中化用曹操称赞孙权之语。

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions and speeches.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案和演讲。

text: 三十功名尘与土，八千里路云和月
pinyin: sān shí gōng míng chén yǔ tǔ, bā qiān lǐ lù yún hé yuè
literal: thirty · merit · fame · dust · and · earth, eight thousand · li · road · clouds · and · moon
natural: At thirty my deeds and fame are as dust; eight thousand li of road lie under clouds and moon

meaning.en: Do not make much of past achievements; keep pushing on; quoted to urge modesty and effort.
meaning.zh: 不要看重已有的功名，应当不断前行，常用来勉励人谦虚和奋斗。

equivalents: don't rest on your laurels
fame is dust, the road is long

examples.zh: 生日时，他用“三十功名尘与土，八千里路云和月”提醒自己。
examples.en: On his birthday he reminded himself with '三十功名尘与土，八千里路云和月'.

examples.zh: “三十功名尘与土，八千里路云和月”，成绩只能代表过去。
examples.en: '三十功名尘与土，八千里路云和月': results only stand for the past.

story.en: Attributed to Yue Fei, the Southern Song general; the authorship is disputed because the poem is not found in sources before the Ming.
story.zh: 传为南宋名将岳飞所作；因明代以前文献未见，作者尚有争议。

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions and speeches.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案和演讲。

text: 莫等闲，白了少年头，空悲切
pinyin: mò děng xián, bái le shào nián tóu, kōng bēi qiè
literal: don't · idle · wait, whiten · [particle] · young · head, in vain · grieve · bitterly
natural: Don't idle away your time, or your young head will turn white and you will grieve in vain

meaning.en: Cherish your youth and work hard, or regret it when it is too late; quoted as advice to the young.
meaning.zh: 珍惜青春努力进取，免得老来后悔，常用来劝勉年轻人。

equivalents: don't waste your youth
time and tide wait for no man

examples.zh: 老师在黑板上写下“莫等闲，白了少年头，空悲切”。
examples.en: The teacher wrote '莫等闲，白了少年头，空悲切' on the blackboard.

examples.zh: 奋斗吧，“莫等闲，白了少年头，空悲切”。
examples.en: Strive on: '莫等闲，白了少年头，空悲切'.

story.en: The famous lines from the same lyric attributed to Yue Fei, urging the young to act before it is too late.
story.zh: 同上，岳飞词，勉励青年莫要空耗光阴。

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions and speeches.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案和演讲。

text: 人生如梦，一尊还酹江月
pinyin: rén shēng rú mèng, yī zūn huán lèi jiāng yuè
literal: life · like · dream, one · cup · still · pour libation to · river · moon
natural: Life is like a dream; let me pour a cup to the river and the moon

meaning.en: A broad-minded sigh at the transience of life and glory; quoted for letting go with a drink.
meaning.zh: 对人生与功名短暂的豁达感叹，常用来表达释怀与洒脱。

equivalents: life is but a dream, raise a glass to the moon
let it go with a cup of wine

examples.zh: 退休那天，他举杯：“人生如梦，一尊还酹江月”。
examples.en: On the day he retired he raised a cup: '人生如梦，一尊还酹江月'.

examples.zh: 读《赤壁怀古》，他最喜欢“人生如梦，一尊还酹江月”这句。
examples.en: Reading 'Reminiscence at Red Cliff', his favourite line is '人生如梦，一尊还酹江月'.

story.en: Su Shi wrote it around 1082 while exiled in Huangzhou, visiting the 'Red Cliff' there and recalling Zhou Yu and the Three Kingdoms.
story.zh: 约1082年苏轼贬居黄州，游当地“赤壁”，追怀周瑜与三国英雄。

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions and speeches.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案和演讲。

text: 会挽雕弓如满月，西北望，射天狼
pinyin: huì wǎn diāo gōng rú mǎn yuè, xī běi wàng, shè tiān láng
literal: will · draw · carved · bow · like · full · moon, west · north · gaze, shoot · Sirius (the invader)
natural: I will draw my carved bow like a full moon, look to the northwest and shoot the Wolf Star

meaning.en: A bold wish to defend the frontier against invaders; quoted for martial ambition and patriotic spirit.
meaning.zh: 豪迈地表示愿保卫边疆、抗击敌人，常用来表达从军报国的志向。

equivalents: I'll draw my bow and strike the enemy
a call to defend the nation

examples.zh: 射箭社的口号是“会挽雕弓如满月，西北望，射天狼”。
examples.en: The archery club's slogan is '会挽雕弓如满月，西北望，射天狼'.

examples.zh: 青年志愿军人高唱“会挽雕弓如满月，西北望，射天狼”。
examples.en: The young volunteers sang '会挽雕弓如满月，西北望，射天狼'.

story.en: Su Shi wrote this around 1075 as prefect of Mizhou, after a hunt, expressing his wish to serve on the northwest frontier against the Xixia.
story.zh: 约1075年苏轼知密州时出猎所作，愿赴西北边塞抗击西夏。

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions and speeches.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案和演讲。

text: 回首向来萧瑟处，归去，也无风雨也无晴
pinyin: huí shǒu xiàng lái xiāo sè chù, guī qù, yě wú fēng yǔ yě wú qíng
literal: turn · head · formerly · desolate · place, go back, neither · no · wind · rain · nor · no · clear sky
natural: Looking back at the bleak place I came through, I go home: neither wind and rain nor clear skies

meaning.en: Calm detachment from both hardship and success; quoted for equanimity and inner peace.
meaning.zh: 对风雨和晴天都不在意，淡然处世，常用来表达从容、平和的心境。

equivalents: neither storm nor sunshine disturbs me
serene equanimity

examples.zh: 经历了起起落落，他悟到“回首向来萧瑟处，归去，也无风雨也无晴”。
examples.en: After the ups and downs he realised '回首向来萧瑟处，归去，也无风雨也无晴'.

examples.zh: 毕业赠言写着“回首向来萧瑟处，归去，也无风雨也无晴”。
examples.en: The graduation message reads '回首向来萧瑟处，归去，也无风雨也无晴'.

origin.source: 苏轼《定风波·莫听穿林打叶声》

story.en: Su Shi wrote this in 1082 in Huangzhou on a walk caught in rain without an umbrella, seeing the storm as a metaphor for life.
story.zh: 1082年苏轼在黄州沙湖道中遇雨，借雨中从容行走抒写人生态度。

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions and speeches.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案和演讲。

text: 笑渐不闻声渐悄，多情却被无情恼
pinyin: xiào jiàn bù wén shēng jiàn qiǎo, duō qíng què bèi wú qíng nǎo
literal: laughter · gradually · not · heard · sound · gradually · faint, feeling · yet · by · unfeeling · vexed
natural: The laughter fades until it is no longer heard, the sound dies away; the one of feeling is vexed by the one without

meaning.en: The pain of one-sided feeling: the girl behind the wall laughs, unaware, while the passer-by who hears her is left vexed; quoted for unrequited love.
meaning.zh: 墙内佳人笑语而浑然不知，墙外多情的行人却因此烦恼，常用来形容单相思。

equivalents: unrequited love
caring more than the other

examples.zh: 暗恋多年，他才懂“笑渐不闻声渐悄，多情却被无情恼”。
examples.en: After years of unrequited love he finally understood '笑渐不闻声渐悄，多情却被无情恼'.

examples.zh: 歌词里有一句“笑渐不闻声渐悄，多情却被无情恼”。
examples.en: The song has the line '笑渐不闻声渐悄，多情却被无情恼'.

origin.source: 苏轼《蝶恋花·花褪残红青杏小》

story.en: The closing lines of Su Shi's lyric, in which a traveller hears a girl laughing over a garden wall and she doesn't know he is there.
story.zh: 该词结尾，行人墙外听见佳人笑语，佳人却浑然不知。

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions and speeches.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案和演讲。

text: 拣尽寒枝不肯栖，寂寞沙洲冷
pinyin: jiǎn jìn hán zhī bù kěn qī, jì mò shā zhōu lěng
literal: pick over · all · cold · branches · not · willing · to perch, lonely · sandbar · cold
natural: It has picked over every cold branch and will not perch; the lonely sandbank is cold

meaning.en: A proud, solitary bird that refuses to compromise; quoted for lofty isolation and for those who won't settle.
meaning.zh: 孤鸿宁愿孤寂也不随便栖息，常用来形容孤高自守、不肯将就的人。

equivalents: too proud to settle
lonely but unyielding

examples.zh: 他至今单身，真是“拣尽寒枝不肯栖，寂寞沙洲冷”。
examples.en: He's still single: truly '拣尽寒枝不肯栖，寂寞沙洲冷'.

examples.zh: 这首词用“拣尽寒枝不肯栖，寂寞沙洲冷”写出诗人的高洁。
examples.en: The poem uses '拣尽寒枝不肯栖，寂寞沙洲冷' to express the poet's loftiness.

origin.source: 苏轼《卜算子·黄州定慧院寓居作》

story.en: Su Shi wrote this in Huangzhou around 1080 in exile; the lone wild goose is a self-portrait of his isolated integrity.
story.zh: 约1080年苏轼贬居黄州定慧院时所作，孤鸿即自身孤高形象。

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions and speeches.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案和演讲。

text: 一年好景君须记，正是橙黄橘绿时
pinyin: yī nián hǎo jǐng jūn xū jì, zhèng shì chéng huáng jú lǜ shí
literal: one · year · fine · scenery · you · must · remember, exactly · is · orange · yellow · tangerine · green · time
natural: The best scenery of the year, you must remember, is just now, when oranges are golden and tangerines still green

meaning.en: Late autumn is as beautiful as spring, so do not despair; quoted to urge appreciation of the present and of autumn.
meaning.zh: 秋末冬初也有好景，不必悲秋，常用来劝人珍惜眼前、欣赏秋色。

equivalents: autumn is the best of the year
cherish the present

examples.zh: 深秋时节，朋友说“一年好景君须记，正是橙黄橘绿时”。
examples.en: In deep autumn, a friend said '一年好景君须记，正是橙黄橘绿时'.

examples.zh: 水果摊的招牌写着“一年好景君须记，正是橙黄橘绿时”。
examples.en: The fruit stall's sign reads '一年好景君须记，正是橙黄橘绿时'.

story.en: Su Shi wrote it around 1090 as prefect of Hangzhou to cheer up his friend Liu Jingwen, who was elderly and unrecognised.
story.zh: 约1090年苏轼知杭州时，赠年老失意的友人刘景文，以此勉励他。

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions and speeches.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案和演讲。
